yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: migrate
spec:
  backoffLimit: 2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: migrate
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: migrate
          image: registry.example.com/web:1.0
          command:
            - bin/migrate
            - --all
          envFrom:
            - secretRef:
                name: db-credentials
      restartPolicy: Never
